31422-(R1853).s: The bill approves for the whole Kingdom of the Netherlands the Council of Europe Convention on the Prevention of Terrorism concluded in Warsaw on 16 May 2005. It also approves a reservation allowing the government to refuse extradition for certain offences considered political offences.
31422-(R1853).j: The memorandum justifies the reservation as allowing refusal of extradition in exceptional cases where a court independently finds the offence political, without imposing an obligation to refuse.
q: By maintaining the reservation it can be ensured that in very exceptional cases where the judge independently considers the requested extradition to concern a political offence, the requested extradition can still be refused.

Door nu het voorbehoud te handhaven kan worden verzekerd dat in zeer uitzonderlijke gevallen waarin de rechter in onafhankelijkheid meent dat de gevraagde uitlevering een politiek delict betreft, toch de gevraagde uitlevering kan worden geweigerd.

parties: Asks whether differing national interpretations of unlawfulness could create legal inequality and lead to proceedings before European courts such as the ECtHR.
Could this not lead to legal inequality, in connection with which proceedings before European judicial bodies such as the ECtHR may be expected?
Kan dit, zo vragen de leden van de CDA-fractie, niet leiden tot rechtsongelijkheid, in verband waarmee procedures bij de Europese gerechtelijke instanties als het EHRM kunnen zijn te verwachten?
Asks whether the convention requires changes to Dutch legislation and how the convention's human rights obligations under the EVRM and ICCPR are ensured.
Warns that the offence definitions are vague and open to multiple interpretations, questions effectiveness, and objects to accession by states doubtful on rule of law and human rights.
The offence descriptions are vague and open to multiple interpretations.
De delictomschrijving zijn vaag en voor meerdere uitleg vatbaar.

v.summary: The Raad van State of the Kingdom supports the Council of Europe Convention on the Prevention of Terrorism but advises stating when the implementing legislation for the Netherlands Antilles and Aruba is expected, or else explaining the consequences of its absence. The government's reply states that the explanatory memorandum has been supplemented accordingly.
concerns: The Council advises specifying when the required implementing legislation for the Netherlands Antilles and Aruba will be ready, or explaining the consequences if it is not.

31792-XII.s: This bill amends the 2008 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Transport and Water Management (XII), adjusting appropriations and expenditure figures in thousands of euros as set out in the attached supplementary budget statement. It sets the effective date of the amendment as 1 December 2008, with retroactive effect if the Staatsblad is published later.
q: the need has emerged for an amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Transport and Water Management (XII) for the year 2008
de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Verkeer en Waterstaat (XII) voor het jaar 2008

31965-VII.s: This bill amends the 2009 budget statutes of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations, adjusting appropriations and receipts across policy and non-policy articles and the operating statements of its service units. The explanatory memorandum details the budgetary effects per article, including reallocations of the year-end margin and changes to the Werkmaatschappij's operating and cash-flow figures.
q: We Beatrix, by the grace of God, Queen of the Netherlands, Princess of Orange-Nassau, etc. etc. etc.
Wij Beatrix, bij de gratie Gods, Koningin der Nederlanden, Prinses van Oranje-Nassau, enz. enz. enz.

32395-XII.s: The bill amends the 2010 departmental budget of the Ministry of Transport and Water Management (XII) following the spring memorandum, adjusting appropriations across policy and non-policy articles. It also amends article 66(5) and (6) of the Comptabiliteitswet 2001 to set out the content of the accountant's report for that ministry's audit service for 2010.
q: Article 4: Article 66(5) and (6) of the Comptabiliteitswet 2001 shall read as follows for the accountant's service of the Ministry of Transport and Water Management for 2010.
Artikel 4 Artikel 66, vijfde en zesde lid, van de Comptabiliteitswet 2001 komt voor de accountantsdienst van het ministerie van Verkeer en Waterstaat voor het jaar 2010 als volgt te luiden

32710-XIII.s: This bill amends the 2010 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation and the budget statement for its operating-cost services, adjusting commitments, expenditure and receipts. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and makes the changes effective from the day after publication in the Staatsblad, retroactive to 31 December of the budget year.
q: Thus it is that We, in common consultation with the States General, have seen fit and resolved, as We hereby see fit and resolve
Zo is het, dat Wij met gemeen overleg der Staten-Generaal, hebben goedgevonden en verstaan, gelijk Wij goedvinden en verstaan bij deze

33090-VIII.s: The bill amends the 2011 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science, adjusting appropriations across policy articles as set out in the attached supplementary statement. It also authorises a multi-year budget reserve under article 5(4) of the Comptabiliteitswet 2001 to fund state guarantees for residual debts of education institutions that default on loans.
33090-VIII.j: The memorandum justifies the deviation from the Comptabiliteitswet as administratively efficient, pending a general statutory provision in the planned revision of that act.
q: For reasons of administrative efficiency it is not desirable to maintain five separate budget reserves charged to the relevant policy articles
Uit een oogpunt van administratieve doelmatigheid is het niet gewenst dat er vijf aparte begrotingsreserves worden aangehouden ten laste van de betrokken beleidsartikelen

33480-XV.s: This bill amends the 2012 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment (second supplementary budget, Najaarsnota) and the budget statement for its business-operations services. It sets the amended amounts in thousands of euros and takes effect on 1 December of the budget year, with retroactive effect if published later.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment (XV) for the year 2012 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid (XV) voor het jaar 2012 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

33750-XV.s: This is the 2014 budget bill (voorstel van wet) for the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment, fixing the departmental budget statement (artikelen 1-2) for expenditure and receipts, with the Agentschap SZW operating-agency budget. It sets amounts in thousands of euros and takes effect on 1 January 2014, with retroactive effect if published later.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment (XV) for the year 2014 attached to this law is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid (XV) voor het jaar 2014 wordt vastgesteld.

33930-XV.s: This bill amends the 2013 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment and the budget statement for its agencies, implementing the final budget adjustment (slotwet) for that year. It sets the budget figures in thousands of euros and takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad, retroactive to 31 December of the budget year.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment (XV) for the year 2013 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid (XV) voor het jaar 2013 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

34200-XVI.s: This is a budget-amendment bill (Slotwet) that adjusts the 2014 departmental budget of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport and the budgets of its executive agencies, to match realised spending. It contains no delegation of rule-making power and no changes to oversight, review or citizens' protections.
q: We have approved and resolved ... The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport (XVI) for the year 2014 is amended
Wij Willem-Alexander ... hebben goedgevonden en verstaan ... De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport (XVI) voor het jaar 2014 wordt gewijzigd

34485-VII.s: This bill amends the 2016 departmental budget of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations (chapter VII) and the 2016 budget of the Rijksdienst voor Identiteitsgegevens agency, in thousands of euros, with effect from 1 June 2016. It is a first supplementary budget that mainly redistributes and increases appropriations for the ministry's policy and central office articles.
q: Thus, We, in common consultation with the States General, have deemed fit and resolved, as We hereby deem fit and resolve
Zo is het, dat Wij met gemeen overleg der Staten-Generaal, hebben goedgevonden en verstaan, gelijk Wij goedvinden en verstaan bij deze

34620-VIII.s: The bill amends the 2016 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science (second supplementary budget), adjusting commitments, expenditure and receipts across policy articles such as primary, secondary, vocational, higher and university education, and studiefinanciering. It also amends the budget statement of the agency Dienst Uitvoering Onderwijs and sets the entry-into-force date.
q: We, with joint consultation of the States General, have approved and resolved
Wij met gemeen overleg der Staten-Generaal, hebben goedgevonden en verstaan

34845-VII.s: This bill amends the 2017 budget (begrotingsstaat) of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations and the agency budget for 2017, through a second supplementary budget, shifting appropriations across policy and non-policy articles. It contains no delegation of rule-making power or changes to oversight, and only sets budget amounts and entry into force.
q: The 2017 budget of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations (VII) is amended as shown in the state attached to this law.
De begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties (VII) voor het jaar 2017 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

34960-XII.s: This bill amends the 2018 departmental budget of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management (XII) and the budget statements for its executive agencies, through a first supplementary budget. The changes are mainly budgetary reallocations and adjustments, such as new commitments, a leenfaciliteit draw by KNMI, and a one-off payment from Rijkswaterstaat to its parent department.
q: We ... have found it necessary to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management for 2018
Wij Willem-Alexander ... hebben goedgevonden en verstaan ... dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat

35095-XII.s: This bill amends the 2018 departmental budget of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management and the budgets of its agencies (second supplementary budget). It changes appropriations and expenditure figures in thousands of euros and takes effect retroactively from 1 December 2018.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management (XII) for the year 2018 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat (XII) voor het jaar 2018 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de bij deze wet behorende staat.

35215-(R2128).s: The bill is a Rijkswet approving the 2007 ILO Work in Fishing Convention for the entire Kingdom of the Netherlands, so that it can be bound by the treaty. The explanatory memorandum sets out the convention's obligations on fishing vessels, flag-state and port-state inspections, and the procedure for amending its annexes.
35215-(R2128).j: The memorandum justifies ratification by pointing to the convention's importance for decent work for fishers, fair competition, support from employers, workers and major fishing states, and the EU's wish to apply it quickly.
q: In the government's view, ratification of the Work in Fishing Convention is of great importance.
Naar de mening van het regering is bekrachtiging van het Verdrag betreffende werk in de visserijsector van groot belang.
d: approval of ILO convention for the Kingdom
amendment of convention annexes I, II and III via ILO procedure
p: The memorandum describes an amendment procedure for the convention's annexes handled through the ILO, which the bill does not subject to further Dutch parliamentary approval.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on a draft Kingdom Act approving the 2007 ILO Work in Fishing Convention, objecting to the claim that the convention contains no provisions binding on everyone and to the unexplained exclusion of inland fishing from its scope. The government's reply accepted both points, adding a list of directly binding provisions and substantiating the inland-fishing exclusion with consultation and sector-specific reasons.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum wrongly claimed the convention contains no provisions binding on everyone; the Afdeling asked for an explanation of which provisions do, such as Article 9 on minimum age, and the government added an overview.

The exclusion of inland fishing vessels under Article 3 was insufficiently justified, lacking reference to consultation and to 'serious problems' as required, and the government substantiated it with consultation and sector-specific reasons.

35258-(R2130).s: The bill approves for the whole Kingdom the 2017 amendment to Article 8 of the Rome Statute of the International Criminal Court, which extends the definition of war crimes. The explanatory memorandum notes the amendment imposes directly binding obligations on individuals under Articles 93 and 94 of the Constitution.
q: This concerns the extension of the criminalisation of war crimes and therefore directly concerns individuals.
Het betreft hier namelijk de uitbreiding van de strafbaarstelling van oorlogsmisdrijven en heeft daarmee direct betrekking op individuen.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State of the Kingdom advised on a draft Rijkswet approving the December 2017 New York amendment to article 8 of the Rome Statute of the International Criminal Court, and found no remarks on it. The minister's reply (nader rapport) transmits the advice and forwards the draft law to the Dutch, Aruban, Curaçao and Sint Maarten legislatures.

35925-VII.s: This bill establishes the 2022 departmental budget statements for the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations and the budget statements for its executive agencies, in thousands of euros. It sets the effective date of the law as 1 January of the budget year, with retroactive effect if published later.
q: The departmental budget statement for the year 2022 belonging to this law is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2022 wordt vastgesteld.

36360-XV.s: This Slotwet amends the 2022 departmental budget of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment, adjusting commitments and expenditure to realised figures across articles including labour market, social assistance and childcare. It takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad and applies retroactively to 31 December of the budget year.
36360-XV.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by explaining underspending, such as delayed implementation of the occupational disease scheme and a delayed government-wide procurement procedure for service cars.
q: There is € 12.1 million less committed and € 7.7 million less spent.
Er is € 12,1 miljoen minder verplicht en € 7,7 miljoen minder uitgegeven.

36600-VIII.s: This bill, the 2025 budget law for the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science, sets the departmental expenditure and receipts budget (about €57.6 billion in expenditure) and the agency budgets for DUO and the National Archives for 2025. The explanatory memorandum describes budget allocations across education, research, culture and media policy, with no new executive powers or delegations of rule-making authority.
q: The departmental budget statement belonging to this law for the year 2025 is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2025 wordt vastgesteld.

36625-XII.s: This bill amends the 2024 budget (second supplementary budget) of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management, changing expenditure and commitment figures across policy and non-policy articles and for the agencies RWS and KNMI. The explanatory memorandum attributes the changes to unpaid invoices from test providers and a commitment shift from 2025 to 2024 for a document management system tender.
36625-XII.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by citing invoice checks that take longer than expected and a commitment shift needed for a tender.
q: There are still a number of invoices that must be paid in 2024.
Er zijn nog een aantal facturen die betaald moeten worden in 2024.

36850-XII.s: The bill amends the 2025 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Waterstaat (second supplementary budget), adjusting expenditure commitments, outlays and receipts across policy articles and agencies such as RWS and KNMI. It also sets the amounts in thousands of euros and makes the amendment effective retroactively from 1 December 2025.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Waterstaat (XII) for the year 2025 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat (XII) voor het jaar 2025 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

36915-VII.s: The bill amends the 2026 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations (chapter VII) and the 2026 budget statement for its agencies, with mutations shown in thousands of euros and retroactive effect to 1 June 2026. It contains no delegation of rule-making power, the change is a budgetary re-allocation of appropriations across policy and non-policy articles.
q: We have considered that the need has emerged for an amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations (VII)
Wĳ in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties (VII)
